turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Thanks, everyone. This is the final checklist review before the release.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: I have the checklist and the open security comments ready.

turns.text: Let's focus on the remaining checklist work and its timing.

turns.text: I can walk through the sections that are still incomplete.

turns.text: I'll flag anything that depends on another team.

turns.text: The release checklist has three remaining sections.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: I can consolidate the checklist and send it to the channel by Friday.

turns.text: Friday is March fourteenth, right?

turns.text: Yes, that's the date I had in mind.

turns.text: The security review may not finish until Monday.

turns.text: Would Monday be safer for the consolidated checklist too?

turns.text: Yes, change my deadline from Friday to Monday; I'll send the consolidated checklist then.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: So Monday, March seventeenth, replaces Friday, March fourteenth.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Correct. Please treat Monday as the only deadline.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: I'll keep the checklist comments open over the weekend.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: We should not create a second task just because the date changed.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Agreed, it's the same consolidation task.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: The release notes can stay in their own document.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: The checklist should link to those notes rather than copy them.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: I'll include the link when I send the consolidated version.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Does the security section need a separate sign-off?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Yes, security owns that sign-off, not this checklist task.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: I'll mark the security section as pending until they respond.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: The review meeting is already booked for Tuesday morning.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: That gives us time to inspect the final checklist.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: I'll send it Monday, March seventeenth.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Then we'll use that version for Tuesday's review.

turns.text: The release notes are stored beside the checklist.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: The security review remains a dependency, not a second checklist deadline.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: I'll link the review status in the document.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: The Tuesday meeting can use the Monday version.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Please retain the date change in the notes.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: The checklist task itself has not changed.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: The final checklist deadline is Monday.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: I'll send the consolidated version on March seventeenth.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: I'll use it for Tuesday's review.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: The earlier Friday date is superseded.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Understood; one task, one final deadline.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: Thanks, that's all from me.
